title: 8. Conflict Breeds Story
use_cases: Use when you need to create a diplomatic twist that hinges on missing trade goods.
Implement when designing a rebellion driven by economic oppression from a tech monopoly.
Configure when building a hero narrative around smuggling life‑saving potions to a quarantined colony.
Use when setting the trigger for war over a century‑cycle ley‑crossing that opens for only one empire.
Apply when weaving trade failures into cultural and survival themes to deepen storytelling.
content:
Trade isn’t just a backdrop—it can drive entire plotlines:

A diplomatic crisis when a magical substance goes missing during a trade exchange.

A rebellion on a planet that’s been economically strangled by a tech monopoly.

A merchant-turned-hero smuggling illegal life-saving potions to a plague-ridden colony.

A war ignited when two empires fight for control over a ley-crossing that only opens once a century.

When trade affects lives, culture, and survival, it becomes a powerful storytelling engine.
